# Sway bar bushings and links

> **[Unverified]** This page rests on a single community report. Cross-check before relying on it.

> Items marked **[Partial]** are only partly confirmed by the source and need more work. They stay in the review queue and are firmed up, corrected or removed as more sources come in.

## Summary

[Partial] Listen for chirping sounds, observe tire dip, check rotational noise pitch, and verify braking changes. [t2943]

## Procedure

> **[Partial]** Needs more work: the verifier could confirm only part of this procedure (the steps marked [Partial], or whether the list is complete). Steps or precautions may be wrong or missing; read the source thread before relying on it. Later runs fill it in as more sources are found.

1. Listen for a chirping sound that occurs under any amount of compression.
2. Observe if the right tire dips lower than the left side when driving.

_Procedure reported by [t2943]._

## Tips & gotchas

- Check if the noise is rotational, changing pitch with speed differences. [t2943]
- [Partial] Verify if the sound stops or changes when touching the brakes to rule out brake wear tabs or sticky slides. [t2943]

## Common mistakes

- [Partial] Assuming a slipping axle sound without verifying under acceleration and deceleration. [t2943]
